title: Chinese Cultural Products Go Global
zh: 中国文化产品走向世界
source: CET-6 · Part IV Translation 汉译英（集训刷题卷）

sentences.zh: 近年来，越来越多的中国文化产品走向全球市场，日益受到海外消费者的青睐。
sentences.en: In recent years, a growing number of Chinese cultural products have entered the global market and become increasingly popular with overseas consumers.

sentences.zh: 随着中国对外文化贸易的快速发展，中国文化产品出口额已持续多年位居世界前列，形成了一批具有国际影响力的文化企业、产品和品牌。
sentences.en: With the rapid development of China's foreign cultural trade, the export value of Chinese cultural products has ranked among the highest in the world for many consecutive years, and a number of internationally influential cultural enterprises, products and brands have emerged.

sentences.zh: 数据显示，中国的出版物、影视作品、网络文学与动漫作品等在海外的销售量连年攀升。
sentences.en: Statistics show that overseas sales of Chinese publications, films and TV dramas, online literature, animations and comics have been rising year after year.

sentences.zh: 中国政府出台了一系列政策鼓励和支持更多具有中国元素的优秀文化产品走出国门，扩大海外市场份额，进一步提升中国文化的世界影响力。
sentences.en: The Chinese government has introduced a series of policies to encourage and support more excellent cultural products with Chinese elements to go global, expand their overseas market share and further enhance the global influence of Chinese culture.

keys.t: ranked among the highest in the world

tips: 时态：“近年来”“已持续多年”“连年攀升”都表示从过去延续到现在，用现在完成时或现在完成进行时（have entered / has ranked / have been rising）。
长句拆分与合并：第 2 句前半讲出口额、后半讲形成品牌，用 and 连接两个分句；第 1 句“走向……，日益受到……”共用主语，用 have entered … and become … 并列。
无主句换主语：“形成了一批……企业、产品和品牌”没有主语，把宾语变成主语：a number of … enterprises, products and brands have emerged。
定语前置：“具有国际影响力的”“具有中国元素的”用副词 + 形容词（internationally influential）或 with 短语，比 which have 定语从句更简洁。
并列动词：“鼓励和支持……走出国门，扩大……，进一步提升……”用 encourage and support … to go global, expand … and further enhance …，三个并列不定式共用一个 to。

consecutive: following one after another without a break
foreign: 对外的；外国的（foreign trade 对外贸易）
global: 全球的（go global 走向世界）
growing: 越来越多的（a growing number of）
internationally: 国际上（internationally influential 具有国际影响力的）
introduced: brought in a new law or policy
literature: 文学（online literature 网络文学）
market: 市场（market share 市场份额）
popular: 受欢迎的（popular with 受……青睐）
recent: 最近的（in recent years 近年来）
share: 份额（market share 市场份额）
value: 价值；金额（export value 出口额）
